query: The Soup Complaint Forty furious letters about the refectory soup have arrived. Nessa wants one calm reply, printed. You decide to dictate it to the quill, which wants very badly to make it more exciting. Keep the quill to the facts Every time it reaches for a flourish, you catch it. The reply comes out calm, true and very dull. Nessa prints it. The quill sulks, and then, grudgingly, writes the next one straight. You blink and the quill has written that the soup contains a mild curse. It prints. You spend Thursday apologising to the cooks. Write the reply by hand You write it yourself, slowly. It's a good reply. The quill watches from the inkwell, offended at being left out.
